G5 responsiveness holds (max main-thread gap 92.6 ms against an idle 93.5 ms), but the 200-node run took about 40 s end to end: library.summarize costs about 211 ms per node, uncached, and the panel worker composes all 200 though show() keeps 60. Keep HARDFIX's additive-logging rule: no root-level logging calls, and no deleted statement in python/synapse/identify/ that a fix does not need. F4 (a standalone sentinel line inside artist text) is out of scope and stays a known issue. Live GUI re-runs of G2, G5 and G6 are the seat's: mark them UNKNOWN. Shell rule (seat, 13:05): keep `#` comments out of every quoted shell argument, including `python -c` and `bash -c`; Claude Code stops for a manual prompt on them and no one is at the keyboard. For any script longer than three lines, Write it to `.scratch/<name>.py` in your worktree (gitignored and allowed) and run that file with python. Never commit anything under `.scratch/`. Tool-output discipline (token-saver): run pytest -q --tb=line -p no:cacheprovider on the files you touch plus the named pins, never the whole suite unless a row demands it; pipe long output through Select-Object -Last 40 or Select-String; never print a whole log, diff or JSON you can grep.
